Individual meets test only if both the 31-day-in-current-year floor (i) and the weighted 3-year day sum reaching 183 (ii) hold together.

(* substantial presence test — §7701(b)(3)(A): 31-day floor plus weighted 3-year day count *)
let has_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_first_preceding_year : int) (days_second_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let weighted_day_sum =
    float_of_int days_current_year
    +. float_of_int days_first_preceding_year /. 3.0
    +. float_of_int days_second_preceding_year /. 6.0
  in
  days_current_year >= 31 &&
  weighted_day_sum >= 183.0

(* 7701(b)(3)(B) — exception to substantial presence test: <183 days plus closer connection to foreign tax home *)
let is_closer_connection_exception (days_present_current_year : int) (has_tax_home_in_foreign_country : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3), without regard to second sentence *) (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool) : bool =
  days_present_current_year < 183 &&
  has_tax_home_in_foreign_country &&
  has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country

(* 7701(b)(3)(C) — exception to the (B) exception: pending adjustment of status or steps toward lawful permanent residency *)
let is_adjustment_of_status_exception (has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool) (has_taken_other_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool) : bool =
  has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application ||
  has_taken_other_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_resident_status

(* 7701(b)(3)(D) — day excluded from presence count: exempt individual or medical condition arising in US *)
let is_excluded_presence_day (is_exempt_individual : bool) (unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_in_united_states : bool) : bool =
  is_exempt_individual ||
  unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_in_united_states

(* 7701(b)(3) wrapper — groups substantial presence test (A) with its exceptions (B), (C), (D); priority resolved externally by DAG *)
module Substantial_presence_test = struct
  let base = has_substantial_presence_test
  let closer_connection_exception = is_closer_connection_exception
  let adjustment_of_status_exception = is_adjustment_of_status_exception
  let excluded_presence_day = is_excluded_presence_day
end
